title: Punishment for those close who lead others to idolatry
description: Moses gives instructions that even one's closest relatives—brother, son, daughter, wife, or dear friend—who secretly entice you to serve other gods must not be spared. The seducer is to be stoned to death, and the person who was led astray must be the first to raise a hand against them. All Israel must hear this and fear, so that such evil is never done again.
